cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Brighter Side
cards.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The car won't start. I've approved a refreshing walk; you may accompany me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we get a taxi? It's pouring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Walking stands. A free shower is an excellent addition to my plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'm stopping at the shoe shop. Mine's leaking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Splendid. A footwear upgrade is approved. You may choose new shoes; this breakdown is improving us from the ground up.

reason: Give B a practical taxi request and then a chosen shoe-shop solution, which A turns into a larger optimistic benefit through approval; preserve the protected source single unchanged.
